title: The point guard job (v2)
goal: Three questions every point guard has to answer, each shown with one full rep from the Monday drill (start on the right, 1v1 down the middle, finish or hand-off)
hooks: Everyone wants to be the point guard. Few know what the job is.
Think you're a point guard because you dribble the most?
Point guard is the most glorified spot on the floor. It's also the hardest.
openLoop: It comes down to three questions.
closeLoop: Most players only train the first two. Number three is the job.

shots.text: Everyone wants to be the point guard
shots.vo: Everyone wants to be the point guard. Few know what the job is.
It comes down to three questions. One: can you protect the ball and handle pressure?

shots.text: 2 · Break down your player, get to your spot
shots.vo: Two: can you break down your player and get to your spot?

shots.text: 3 · Initiate the offence & make the play
shots.vo: Three: can you initiate the offence and make plays under pressure? Into the hand-off, read it, make the right play.
Most players only train the first two. Number three is the job.
